1: Which found items are his, and which items is he obligated to announce - The explanation of that which it teaches, "Which found items are his"; and it does not teach, "Which found items is he not obligated to announce" is [that it is] to make us understand that even if the other brought witnesses that it fell from him, we do not give it to him. For since it is something that does not have an identifying mark, he presumably surely abandoned it and it became ownerless.
